copy.tagline: 在本地部署虚拟MCP服务器进行手动测试
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在本地运行虚拟MCP服务器来验证配置
copy.tagline_en: Deploy a virtual MCP server locally for manual testing
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to run a virtual MCP server locally to verify configurations

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 会指导你在本地 Kind 集群中部署和测试 VirtualMCPServer 配置，包括创建集群、应用 YAML、验证状态、测试 MCP 端点等步骤。
howto.when: 当你需要手动测试 VirtualMCPServer 配置，或要求部署本地测试环境时触发。

say.text: 帮我在本地 Kind 集群中部署一个 VirtualMCPServer。
say.note: Claude 会引导你完成集群创建和配置部署。

say.text: 测试我本地的 vMCP 端点是否正常工作。
say.note: Claude 会指导你获取端口并发送测试请求。

say.text: 清理本地的 vMCP 测试环境。
say.note: Claude 会指导你删除资源或销毁集群。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will guide you through deploying and testing VirtualMCPServer configurations in a local Kind cluster, including creating the cluster, applying YAML, verifying status, and testing MCP endpoints.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to manually test VirtualMCPServer configurations or request a local test environment setup.

say_en.text: Help me deploy a VirtualMCPServer in a local Kind cluster.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through cluster creation and configuration deployment.

say_en.text: Test if my local vMCP endpoint is working.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you to get the port and send test requests.

say_en.text: Clean up the local vMCP test environment.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you to delete resources or destroy the cluster.
